posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 5-6 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, distinct from the primary vertical line structures.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white spot on the lower cheek/mandible area and white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves.
